steps.comment: accept SQS event where each record body is the raw API request body and send email

processors.script:
const event = JSON.parse(context.getBody()); const input = JSON.parse(event.Records[0].body); context.setProperty(`senderEmail`, input.fromEmail); context.setBody(`This email was sent from the website.

from: ${input.fromName}<${input.fromEmail}>
Company: ${input.company}

Message:
${input.message}`)

context.setProperty(`status_code`, context.sendToStep(`aws-services`, `ses-request`, JSON.stringify( { path : `/v2/email/outbound-emails`, method : `POST`, body : { FromEmailAddress: context.getData(`fromAddress`), Destination : { ToAddresses : JSON.parse(context.getData(`toAddress`))}, Content: { Simple : { Subject: { Data: `${context.getData(`subject`)} - ${context.getProperty(`senderEmail`)}` }, Body : { Text : { Data : context.getBody() }}}}}})).getProperty(`status_code`))
